annotations.title: Who follows an X account (or who it follows)

description: The follower or following LIST for an X account — handles, names, bios, locations and each one’s own follower/following/post counts. The COUNTS are already free on x_account and x_user; this is WHO, which is what audience analysis and creator vetting actually need. With no username it reads the CONNECTED account (“who follows us”); pass a handle to read anyone public (“who follows our competitor”). Warning: NEEDS THE follows.read PERMISSION, added 2026-08-31: an X connection authorized before that date does NOT carry it and cannot have it added — the tool says so and asks for a reconnect rather than surfacing X’s raw refusal. Default 20, max 100 per call (X bills per account returned); page with nextToken. Needs X connected.

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

paginationToken.description: next page token from the previous reply

username.description: handle with or without the @ — omit to read the connected account
